LESSON: ACTIVE LISTENING, INTERACTIVE SPEAKING

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: GERMAN
Strand: Listening and speaking
Topic 1.7: Active Listening, Interactive speaking
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 3

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Active Listening, Interactive speaking, part of Listening and speaking in Grade 9 GERMAN.

Key inquiry question: How can one maximise active listening as a skill? 16 Schmerzen?

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Self-efficacy: the learner develops the ability to express oneself on illnesses they suffer from.

Values:
Love: the learner demonstrates the value of compassion when s/he discusses with peers what kind of illnesses they suffer
